mapper.sql: id, merchant_id, category_id, name, food_type, price, stock, description, cover_url, avg_score, review_count, sales_count, recommend_tag, status, created_at, updated_at, deleted
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM food_item WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT f.id, f.merchant_id, m.shop_name, m.campus_area, f.category_id, f.name, f.food_type, f.price, f.stock, f.description, f.cover_url, f.avg_score, f.review_count, f.sales_count, f.recommend_tag, f.status
ORDER BY f.avg_score DESC, f.sales_count DESC, f.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT f.id, f.merchant_id, m.shop_name, m.campus_area, f.category_id, f.name, f.food_type, f.price, f.stock, f.description, f.cover_url, f.avg_score, f.review_count, f.sales_count, f.recommend_tag, f.status, f.taste_tags, f.ingredients FROM food_item f INNER JOIN merchant m ON m.id = f.merchant_id AND m.deleted = 0 WHERE f.deleted = 0 AND f.status = 1 AND m.audit_status = 1 AND m.status = 1 ORDER BY f.sales_count DESC, f.avg_score DESC, f.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT f.id, f.merchant_id, m.shop_name, m.campus_area, f.category_id, f.name, f.food_type, f.price, f.stock, f.description, f.cover_url, f.avg_score, f.review_count, f.sales_count, f.recommend_tag, f.status FROM food_item f INNER JOIN merchant m ON m.id = f.merchant_id AND m.deleted = 0 WHERE f.id = #{id} AND f.deleted = 0 AND f.status = 1 AND m.audit_status = 1 AND m.status = 1

SELECT
FROM food_item WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND deleted = 0

SELECT f.id, f.merchant_id, m.shop_name, m.campus_area, f.category_id, f.name, f.food_type, f.price, f.stock, f.description, f.cover_url, f.avg_score, f.review_count, f.sales_count, f.recommend_tag, f.status, f.taste_tags, f.ingredients
ORDER BY f.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
mapper.update: UPDATE food_item SET avg_score = ROUND((avg_score * review_count + #{score}) / (review_count + 1), 2), review_count = review_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
